# Clausemaster - LLM Context

> Clausemaster is a free tool by TODO.LAW that turns legal documents into installable AI skills. Upload a contract, policy or assessment (PDF, DOCX or TXT), get a clause-by-clause analysis with flagged issues, and generate a reusable legal skill from it. Skills are dual-format: they install into your own todo.law deployments and load in LegalQuants-community runtimes and other agent-skill hosts.

## Public Pages

- [Homepage](https://clausemaster.todo.law): Product overview and sign-in
- [Documentation Hub](https://clausemaster.todo.law/docs): Quick start and links to every guide

- [AI Analysis Pipeline](https://clausemaster.todo.law/docs/analysis): How the three-step analysis works and the AI provider tiers
- [Review System](https://clausemaster.todo.law/docs/reviews): Expert review workflow from request to completion

## What Clausemaster Does

- **Three-Step AI Pipeline**:
  1. **Classification**: Identify contract type, jurisdiction, parties and document category
  2. **Clause Extraction**: Summarize each clause with legal significance and bias assessment
  3. **Issue Flagging**: Flag issues by severity (Info / Warning / Critical)
  Analysis runs as a series of steps; a typical document completes within a few minutes
- **Two-Tier AI Provider System**:
  - **Community (Free)**: Open-weights model hosted by the platform, no API key needed
  - **Bring Your Own Key**: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Groq, Mistral or Together AI
  - Per-user provider selection, switchable anytime from Settings
  - All API keys encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM)
- **Multi-Format Support**: Upload PDF, DOCX or TXT documents
- **Jurisdiction-Specific Insights**: Analysis calibrated to applicable legal jurisdictions
- **Reference Skills as Context**: Analysis draws on the open LegalQuants reference skills
- **Skill Draft Generation**: AI-assisted creation of contract and assessment skills, reviewed in a draft editor before publishing
- **Dual-Format Publishing**: One publish produces both the todo.law engine data and a standard agent skill (SKILL.md, README, parameters, evaluation cases)
- **Where Skills Run**: Contract skills install into Dealroom and assessment skills into DPO Central on your own todo.law deployment; AI Sentinel skills can be authored but not yet installed. The same folder loads in LegalQuants runtimes such as LQ.AI and in other agent-skill hosts
- **Expert Review**: Startups can request lawyer review of an analyzed contract
- **Free to Use**: Clausemaster is not a marketplace. There is no revenue share and nothing to sell

## TODO.LAW Ecosystem

Clausemaster is part of the TODO.LAW platform for AI-native legal services:

- **Dealroom** (dealroom.todo.law) - Contract negotiation
- **DPO Central** (dpocentral.todo.law) - Privacy compliance management
- **AI Sentinel** (aisentinel.todo.law) - AI governance and EU AI Act compliance
- **Seneca** (seneca.todo.law) - Privacy litigation research
- **Vendor.Watch** (vendor.watch) - SaaS vendor compliance database
- **Clausemaster** (clausemaster.todo.law) - Legal documents into installable AI skills
- **Gavel** (gavel.todo.law) - Digital arbitration protocol

For full ecosystem context, see: https://todo.law/llms-full.txt
